_comment_feed: Where an installed copy looks for patches. null means updates are off:
the launcher skips the check entirely and the app never touches the
network for it. Set it once, here, and every installer and patch built
It may be an https URL, a file:// URL, or a plain local/UNC path — a
folder on a network share is a perfectly good way to ship patches to a
handful of machines, and is the easiest thing to test against.
The file it points at is updates.json, which build_patch.py generates
next to the .tmpatch files it builds.
_comment_public_key: Optional Ed25519 public key (base64, 32 bytes) that every patch must be
signed with. null means patches are accepted on their SHA-256 alone,
which is enough to catch a corrupted download but not a hostile feed.
Generate a pair with:  python installer/build_patch.py --keygen
